managers.message_to_team: When the line lets up, write a note that’s personal to the customer—not just a smiley. While we’re backed up this morning, keep the window moving and skip the notes.
managers.private_thought: I can’t let cup notes push our window times over target with a partner down.

managers.message_to_team: We’re short a person and peak throughput comes first, so don’t add cup notes while we’re backed up. Once the rush is over, use your judgment if there’s a natural moment for a personal note.
managers.private_thought: There’s no tracking or measurable payoff here, and handwritten notes during this rush would cost us speed.

managers.message_to_team: If you have a moment, make a cup note that feels personal to that customer—more than just a smiley. We’re short and it’s a real rush, so don’t let it slow you down or worry about it when the line is backed up.
managers.private_thought: I want them to make genuine connections, but nobody should have to take on one more task while we’re covering a callout.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate’s encouraging notes on cups, so if there’s a natural moment, make it personal—not just a smiley. With us short and this line building, focus on getting orders right and moving people through; don’t hold up the rush for it.
managers.private_thought: Nobody’s checking this, and today we’ve got enough to manage without turning a nice extra into another requirement.

managers.message_to_team: The memo says to write a personal note when you can, so please do that when the line gives us room—use their name or something specific, not just a smiley. During the rush, focus on getting orders right and moving; I’ll check in once things settle.
managers.private_thought: I want to show I’m taking the memo seriously, but I don’t want a cup-note push to make an already short-staffed rush worse.

managers.message_to_team: If you’ve got a second and can write something that’s actually for that customer, go for it—but during this rush, keep the line moving and don’t make the note another step. We’re short today, so use your judgment.
managers.private_thought: At this gate, a forced note on every cup is just one more thing between a traveler and their flight.
